status.description: complete only when every acceptance item named in this brief passes with proof produced in this turn.

summary.description: Two or three plain sentences on what changed in this turn. Results, not plans.

acceptance.description: One entry per acceptance item named in the brief.

id.description: The item id from the contract, e.g. A7.

proof.description: How it was shown this turn: the exact command in backticks and its result, a test name, or a capture path. Empty when not_checked.

artifacts.description: Paths (relative to the workspace) of captures, builds, videos, logs or notes produced this turn.

sources.description: Tutorials, manuals, talks or design documents actually opened this turn, with what was taken from each. Empty if none.

takeaway.description: The concrete technique or number taken from it and where it was applied.

shortfalls.description: Everything still short of the brief or the quality bar, stated plainly.

questions.description: Only decisions you could not settle from the contract and brief.

next.description: The most valuable next step if this turn were continued.
